messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for setting out the cost weights behind your quote. We recognise the upward pressure on processing costs, but the price effect needs to be reconciled with your actual costs and existing alloy coverage.

Even taken at face value, the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - explain at most about +7.5% on the price, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

A longer commitment gives you purchasing predictability in return for a lower, evidenced price. We are flexible on payment terms, and the option retaining your requested payment terms is included below; please choose whichever works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.63 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 4.57 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 4.58 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We appreciate your openness and look forward to agreeing a defensible basis for our continued partnership.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We appreciate your detailed review of the cost indices and your willingness to commit to a 24-month agreement. To support this longer duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over two years is not feasible. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Based on this adjustment and your preferred 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.49 per unit. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for lowering your price and clarifying the material share. We recognise that a longer agreement needs protection against future alloy movements, while processing costs must remain distinct from covered material costs.

Your latest offer is still 2.0% above today's price of EUR 5.45.

Our modest price step and longer commitment support your purchasing predictability; we now look for a reciprocal price concession. We are flexible on the deadband within your requested alloy index clause; please choose the option that best fits your material exposure. We have taken your point on a fixed price: every option below includes an index clause.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.71 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 60 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.60 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 60 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.66 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 60 days net, 24-month agreement.

Can we review the material and processing calculation together and clarify how fixed coverage, the index base, adjustment timing and annual price wording interact without double counting?

We appreciate your pragmatic approach and want to reach a defensible agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
